author: _Nathy
body:
Ok I'm expecting a ban within 24 hours, we even changed the rules several months ago to get him banned ffs.

"I have been criticized for the methods I use to push my agenda on avicus which include: threatening, ddosing, keylogging, leaking, and blackmailing. I find my methods effective"

Oh come on, he is giving you all you need to ban him....

This is clearly breaking the following rule:

A9:
"Threatening someone in any way, on most Avicus services, will not be tolerated. This may include, but is not limited to, DDOS, Dox, and death threats of any form. Their are exceptions to this rule on Avicus Teamspeak, depending on the channel you are in"

The other things he mentions in his post: Keylogging, leaking and Blackmailing are somehow not explicitly stated on the rule page and I am struggling to see why they are not. I'd recommend having that rectified very quickly.

Many people have been demoted and banned for leaking, Aura being the first that comes to mind. Zac should have been banned years ago.

In regards to keylogging, I had a little look at US law and found that as stated in the Electronic Communications Privacy Act it is a crime to obtain communications of others without court or individual approval. As he states himself, he is working as part of an operation with other colleagues. He gave us a list of people who they had keylogged: "Arigenn (currently), Para (at least formerly, Keenan (at least formerly), multiple current and former developers, at least 2 officials, at least 5 moderators, at least 1 junior moderator, at least 1 senior moderator"

With these people keylogged, he would have access to all slack chats (Communication) staff subforums (Also a form of staff members to communicate in private matters) clearly violating this law.


We know he finds loopholes, but Zac cannot loophole rule A9 however as it is clearly stated that threatening and DDoSing will not be tolerated. I'm going to go out on an assumption here and say that he has broken this rule more than 99% of people in our community. Others who have done this have been banned instantly, so the same rule must apply to Zac.

Regards, Nathy
